## #2 — Martin — 2006-11-22
<https://www.cheetah3d.com/forum/index.php?threads/1075/post-6718>

Hi,
and welcome to the forum. I've seen you in the Unity forum.

The language is the same but the API is different. But that shouldn't a to big problem. If you are familier with Unity using the Cheetah3D API should be quite easy.

Unity is also using a more advanced Javascript version which is very close to Javascript 2.0. So in Unity you can define your own classes while that isn't possible in the Spidermonkey Javascript engine which just implements Javascript 1.5.

Bye,
Martin
